en: The image shows the address side of a vintage postcard. At the top center is the printed heading "POSTKAART - CARTE POSTALE" in red. On the right is a red postage stamp with a circular cancellation mark reading "TALLINN" and the country indication "EESTI". Two hole punches appear near the right edge. On the left is a purple oval business stamp containing an address in Tallinn. Red horizontal guide lines are printed for the recipient's address, which is handwritten in a cursive script, addressed to someone in Haapsalu. There is no view or picture side visible in this image.
